result.evidence:
I checked branch v2/t-bank-all at a6bc1b6, detached in the worktree, with no commits. Master and branch were each extracted with git archive to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-workingmyassof-satbank/9030c288-6222-49fa-a25a-6e6802e22cd3/scratchpad/tvd_aca7/{master,branch}, and I checked that the imported package path matched each one.

1. MCQ matches master. I dumped every field of every template in the topic for seeds 0-80 in three modes: default, fmt="mcq" and fmt="spr". Only point_read and predict_from_line accept fmt; the other templates raise TypeError on both branches. That is 4374 records, and every MCQ record is field-for-field identical to master, with 0 differences. I also read the code: pool_at(gap, prec, gap) rebuilds master's old pool exactly, and moving pick() ahead of the spr return in point_read uses no rng, so the MCQ output cannot change.

2. Grid-ins differ from master only in spr_mistakes. After removing spr_mistakes, every grid-in record equals master. This covers point_read with fmt="spr", predict_from_line from the default draw (the beach question), forced fmt="spr" predict_from_line, rate_of_change and slope_scaled. The last two carry no spr_mistakes because they have no mistake pool, which is safe. No MCQ item carries spr_mistakes.

3. Checking the reasons:
- I recomputed 30 random grid-ins by hand: 13 point_read and 17 predict_from_line (seeds 46, 26, 54, 14, 17, 70, 2, 50, 15, 67, 33, 12, 19; and predict 31, 3, 50, 0, 63, 45, 30, 5, 77, 47, 1, 69, 54, 49, 48, 27, 34). Every value came out as its reason says, from the stem and params, including the dedup order and the key-equal drops.
- An independent reimplementation that shares no generator code covered 192 grid-ins at seeds 0-80 and 1140 at seeds 81-599. It found 0 value mismatches.
- It also checked whether each misread lands somewhere the SVG actually draws something. This is where the defects below come from, and all of them are in forced fmt="spr" predict_from_line draws. The server calls generate(template, seed) without fmt, so it never serves these forced draws. tools/spr_coverage.py and this task's own step-2 dump do count them as grid-ins.
- Ties are not a defect. In about 26 draws, including the production beach draw at default seed 66 (x=30 is equally near points at 29.55 and 30.45), "read the plotted point nearest the given x-value" names one of two equally near points. The value is still a true reading of one of them.

4. Gate: running PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m satbank check --topic two_variable_data prints PASS: coverage 39/39, transcript 39/39, acceptance 39/39 at 90%, audit 5,392, structure 100%, prose 5,392, table 600, capacity 19,216+.

Verdict: items 1, 2 and 4 hold, and every value is arithmetically right. Item 3 fails because some grid-in reasons describe a reading that the drawn chart makes impossible, or refer to a line that is not drawn. That is why pass is false.

defects.where: satbank/topics/two_variable_data/families/fit.py predict_from_line, spr branch (spr_pool = pool_at(step, typed, typed))
defects.what: Some misreads land outside the drawn chart, so the student could not have read that value, which makes the reason impossible for this question. (1) fmt='spr' seed 56 (planetoid at 0.8 AU, key 4.6): 'read the line two gridlines above where it crosses' = 5.6, but the y-axis ends at 5.5. (2) Seed 452 (planetoid at 2.8 AU, key 3.2): 'two gridlines below' = 2.2, but the axis starts at 2.5. (3) Seed 399 (x = 33, key 0.6): 'two gridlines below' = -0.4, below the y=0 axis. On the same item, 'read the line one gridline to the right of the given x-value' = -0.5 at x=34, where the drawn line has already been clipped at y=0 (it stops near x=33.5). (4) Seed 460 (x = 28, key 4.9): 'read the line where the data ends' = -0.5 at x=34, where the line is also clipped away. Seeds 115 and 588 have the same kind of off-window gridline misread. The code already drops half_x when it falls off the chart but has no equivalent guard for the others.
defects.fix: In the spr branch, after y0 and y1 are computed, set a misread to None when its value is outside [y0, y1]. For the x-shifted reasons (x_left/x_right/at_end/at_start/half_x), also set it to None when m*x+b is outside [y0, y1] at that x, since the line is not drawn there, or when x is outside [x0, x1]. This leaves the MCQ pool untouched.

defects.where: satbank/topics/two_variable_data/families/fit.py predict_from_line, spr branch, PREDICT_CTX[5] (grape juice, no_line=True)
defects.what: The grape-juice chart draws no line of best fit: the stem says 'According to the trend shown by the data', and it is called with line=None. Its grid-in spr_mistakes still tell the student they 'read the line one/two gridlines below/above where it crosses', 'read the line one gridline to the left/right', 'read the line where the data ends/starts' or read a point 'instead of the line'. Example: fmt='spr' seed 49, key 1150, where 1100 is named 'read the line one gridline below where it crosses'. There were 579 such reason instances across the forced-spr grape-juice draws I scanned. The wording is copied from master's MCQ reasons, which must stay as they are, but these grid-in entries are new and the words do not match the figure.
defects.fix: Only in the spr branch, when d.get('no_line') is set, either reword the reasons (for example 'read the trend of the data one gridline below...' and 'instead of the trend') or drop the line-reading reasons. The MCQ pool and its reasons stay unchanged.
